response.sql: WITH per_account AS (SELECT t.account_id AS account_id, a.frequency AS frequency, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount END) AS acct_avg FROM trans t JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE t.type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ') GROUP BY t.account_id, a.frequency), with_freq AS (SELECT account_id, frequency, acct_avg, AVG(acct_avg) OVER (PARTITION BY frequency) AS freq_avg FROM per_account) SELECT account_id, frequency, acct_avg, acct_avg / NULLIF(freq_avg, 0) AS ratio FROM with_freq ORDER BY (acct_avg / NULLIF(freq_avg, 0)) IS NULL, ratio DESC, account_id LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The 'account number' is trans.account_id (the request says so explicitly). Only PRIJEM and VYDAJ rows are included; VYBER and other types are excluded, as requested.
If a frequency's average is 0, the ratio is NULL (via NULLIF), and NULL ratios sort last. Ties on ratio are broken by account_id ascending, which the request doesn't specify.
